newsitem.title: BELGIUM: RESEARCH ALERT - Arbed upgrated to 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Arbed upgrated to 'buy'.

text.p: Belgium's Generale Bank said on Wednesday it upgraded shares in Luxembourg steel maker Arbed to 'buy' from 'hold', adding Arbed was "an interesting trading opportunity during the coming months."
Despite a 21 percent rise since the beginning of the year Arbed lagged Usinor of France, up 41 percent, and Dutch Hoogovens, up 51 percent.
Generale Bank said Arbed's price earnings and price cash-flow ratios compared favourably with its peers.

It said its more positive stance for Arbed was not based on recent comments of Arbed chief executive officer Joseph Kinsch, who told last Friday's annual meeting the positive effect of a recovery in prices and demand would be felt in the results of the coming quarters.
"We see 1997 as a transitional year, with a still very weak first half-year," Generale Bank said.
On a higher Brussels bourse Arbed shares were up 100 francs at 4,290 francs at 1330 GMT.
